name: Companion Name Probe
author: vkays
description: A probe, not content. Tests whether CSetCharacterDisplayNameAction can rewrite a companion's display name repeatedly from a Damaged Script Action, so that pointing at a companion could tell you how hurt they are. The class is real (6 vanilla uses, and %s[OldName] interpolates the previous name) but every shipped use is a one-shot rename inside a conversation. Fernand gets a fixed string so the question is only 'does it fire'; Fang gets %s[OldName]! so each hit appends an exclamation mark and the invocations become countable; and the companion conversation gets four replies to test the same class from dialogue against three different target tokens. Uninstall before testing anything else.
